annotations.text:
Flow: Landing (Request a pilot / Sign in) → /login → Authenticate → /dashboard.
'Explore the Rajkot demo mission' → /demo (read-only command center, simulated data).
Click Authenticate to play the sign-in sequence; 'Sign out · reset demo' returns to idle.

Dashboard: switch Energy / Agri / Rescue in the top bar — KPIs, alerts, classes and the 3D twin all change.
Click an alert row or a 3D marker to link them. 'Open mission twin' → 04. '+ New inspection' → 05.

Mission twin: drag to orbit, click a marker or a list row to open the inspection dossier. Timeline plays the flight back; detection ticks sit where each target was captured.
'Generate report' → 06.
New inspection: pick a pillar, review uploaded media (EXIF GPS found or missing per file), choose the telemetry source, then Run inference to watch the pipeline and the 3D flight manifest fill in.
Mission report: printable PDF preview and the JSON export, both built from the session payload (pillar, telemetry, detections, inference time). Provenance statement is mandatory in both.

Mission IDs, sites, aircraft, members and most numbers on screens 03–26 are SAMPLE DATA for the golden demo and are labelled on screen. Screens 24 (Models) and 28 (Solutions) use the REAL training results, dataset sizes and weight files from models/. Bracketed values like [AIRFRAME MODEL] are placeholders to fill in.

Missions log: filter by status and telemetry source, search, select rows (bulk bar appears). The 3D area-of-operations map pins every site; the selected mission's pin pulses and its survey footprint is drawn.

Live ops: simulated FPV feed rendered from the drone's pose with flight HUD and detection boxes; the tactical map is the same twin in follow view, kept in sync. Pause / RTH / Mark point are simulated controls.
Analytics: range filter, detections by severity, 3D density surface, resolution funnel, confidence distribution vs the 0.50 threshold, inference time per mission, top sites.
10 Sites → 11 Site detail (click a card or a pin). 12 Fleet → 13 Aircraft detail (click an aircraft). Fleet hardware is sample data; no aircraft are linked.

14 Mission planner: drag the four survey-area corners on the terrain; lanes, flight time, frames and battery count update live; export writes a telemetry manifest. 15 Reports archive. 16 Frame gallery with viewer. 17 Public demo with guided tour (no sign-in).

18 System status and 19 Signal lost (404 / 500). 20–25 Settings share one layout with a sub-navigation: Profile, Organization, Team & roles, API keys & integrations, Models (real training metrics), Audit log.

Marketing site (left of the landing page): 27 Platform (interactive 3D pipeline), 28 Solutions (one page per pillar with real model card), 29 About / Contact (variant switch). 26 Request access / Forgot password sits under the login screen.
